Adcendo ApS is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. We are developing a pipeline of first-in-class antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) targeting cancers with high unmet medical needs. Led by a team of industry veterans with a strong track record in advancing ADCs and biologics, Adcendo combines novel targets, optimized linker-payload technologies and a rational development strategy to bring next-generation cancer therapies to patients.

We are looking for a dedicated Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing to join our CMC team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing the monoclonal antibody manufacturing process across our pipeline projects. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, CMC project management, QA and external CDMOs to ensure robust development, manufacturing and regulatory readiness of our mAb-based drug substance activities.

This position requires strong scientific and technical expertise within biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing, particularly monoclonal antibodies, as well as solid experience working with external manufacturing partners in a GMP-regulated environment.

The role

As Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing at Adcendo, your responsibilities will include:

• Development of mAb manufacturing process development across projects in collaboration with CMC PM and CDMO

• Vendor selection, oversight and evaluation of CDMOs within mAb manufacturing

• Coordination of scientific and technical work associated with mAb manufacturing within pipeline projects

• Author and review appropriate CMC sections of IND and BLA submissions

• Review of GMP/GDP out of specifications (OOS), deviations, change controls, complaints and distribution in collaboration with QA

• Review of validation protocols, validation strategies, risk assessments such as FMEA

• Review and approve mAb process development. manufacturing documentation and other technical reports to support regulatory filings

• Review stability data and establish shelf life in collaboration with QA

Qualifications and experience

Our ideal candidate has solid experience from a similar role within biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing. You have a strong understanding of CMC development in a biotech or pharma setting and are comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple projects, external partners and stakeholders across geographies.

You bring both scientific depth and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset, enabling you to make sound decisions while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.

We expect that you have:

• Relevant academic background in sciences as a Pharmacist, Biochemist, Chemist or Engineer and experience with development of biopharmaceutical products

• At least 5 – 10 years relevant industry experience

• Working in a GMP environment and have experience in pharmaceutical development e.g. manufacturing or analytical development and project management.

• Deep experience within development and manufacturing of monoclonal antibodies, establishment of cell banks, upstream and downstream processing.

• Experience within tech transfer of manufacturing processes

• Experience within lates stage development, process validation and BLA filings

• Management of external relationships and outsourced contract manufacturing organizations

• Excellent collaboration skills

As a person, you are structured, quality-focused and proactive. You thrive in a growing biotech company where priorities may evolve, and you are motivated by contributing to the development of innovative therapies for patients with high unmet medical needs.

Other details

• The position is full-time and comes with the expectation of significant on-site presence at our Copenhagen offices

• Approximately 10–20 travel days per year are expected

• The Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing reports to the Executive Director, CMC Project Management

Working at Adcendo

At Adcendo, we are on a mission to develop breakthrough antibody-drug conjugate therapies for cancers with high unmet medical needs. Our work is guided by a patient-centric, science-driven approach and powered by a passionate team committed to quality, performance and innovation.

We believe great science happens in a culture of collaboration, respect and transparency. At Adcendo, you will find cross-functional teamwork, opportunities to grow and the balance needed to thrive both personally and professionally.

How to apply

If you thrive in an international environment and have strong experience with mAb manufacturing from Pharma or Biotech, we encourage you to apply and join us at this exciting time for Adcendo.

To apply, please submit your CV including a short motivation for applying for the job. If you have any questions regarding this position, please send them to f.cetinkaya@aims-germany.com. Please read about Data Privacy for job applicants on our website: www.adcendo.com.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

Join us in shaping an emerging biotech company and the future of cancer treatment.

Adcendo – Designed for Precision. Developed for Life.

Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

Do you have experience with customer service, and want to deliver high-level service to employees in a global company? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment with many different tasks and desire to work in an organization with many possibilities? Then you might be our new student assistant at Nordic Support.

Our Team

Our Nordic Support team currently includes colleagues across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Iceland, and we have recently transformed from local support desks to a centralized entity to support our end-users across all the Nordic countries. Qualifications

We are looking for a positive, open-minded, and very structured student assistant who can work independently but also as a team player. Your tasks will require good communication skills. You master English on a high level both in writing and speech, as we work in an international organization.

Furthermore, you are someone who demonstrates the following:

• Quick learner who wants to be challenged, as Deloitte uses several internally developed special applications

• Are independent, service-minded, and solution-oriented, just as you can participate in interdisciplinary collaboration

Our everyday lives are sometimes hectic, and we expect you to be helpful and ambitious, show initiative, flexibility, integrity, and a great sense of responsibility for the task ahead. In return, we can assure you, that you will be positively challenged in all your skillsets in a large, international company with a high professional standard, and an opportunity for development.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. About FLOWVISION A/S

FLOWVISION A/S is a Danish engineering company founded in 2006, specialized in designing and delivering advanced emission abatement systems for combustion-based power plants worldwide. Since 2021, the company has been part of AXENS GROUP, while continuing to operate as an independent business with its own organization, commercial responsibility, and market-facing role.

The company operates in an international EPC environment and delivers technically advanced solutions to customers within the energy, oil & gas, and industrial sectors across multiple global markets. FLOWVISION collaborates closely with major international players and is recognized for its strong technical know-how, high-quality standards, and ability to solve complex engineering challenges.

Today, FLOWVISION employs around 20 highly skilled specialists, creating a strong concentration of technical competencies and deep industry expertise. This gives the company the agility and close collaboration of a small expert team, combined with the backing and broader industrial context of being part of Axens.

FLOWVISION offers a flat organizational structure, short decision-making processes, and a collaborative culture where openness, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are essential parts of everyday life.

The company is currently experiencing significant growth and a strong order intake, creating attractive opportunities for professionals who want to influence both project execution and the continued development of the business.

The position

As E&I Engineer, you will become part of FLOWVISION's highly specialized engineering environment and play a central role in the electrical and instrumentation execution of technically advanced international projects.

You will work closely with Project Management, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSE, workshops, suppliers, and external engineering partners. Your responsibility is to ensure that electrical designs, components, documentation, and technical interfaces are correct, practical, cost-effective, and ready for fabrication, installation, and inspection.

The role combines detailed engineering with practical project execution. You will work from customer specifications and standards through design, procurement, supplier clarification, fabrication support, FAT, and final documentation. A particularly important part of the role is specifying and selecting electric motors and associated electrical equipment for FLOWVISION's systems.

This is not a PLC programming position. However, you need a sound understanding of control systems, instrumentation, signal exchange, I/O architecture, software logic, and control philosophy. Some PLC programming experience will be an advantage when reviewing interfaces and supporting project execution.

The position is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex specifications into clear requirements, making sound technical decisions, and following issues through to completion.

Key responsibilities

Electrical and instrumentation project execution

·   Review customer RFQs, technical specifications, standards, and requirements, identifying clarifications, risks, assumptions, and consequences for price, schedule, and execution.

·   Translate customer requirements and agreed project scope into clear electrical and instrumentation requirements for suppliers and external engineering partners.

·   Prepare and maintain electrical diagrams, I/O lists, cable lists, datasheets, logic diagrams, bills of materials, and component specifications.

·   Specify and select electric motors and related components based on process duty, performance, electrical data, operating conditions, applicable standards, ATEX requirements, cost, and delivery time.

·   Design junction boxes and define cables, glands, terminals, and associated electrical hardware.

·   Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical and process disciplines, including cable routing, instrument connections, signal exchange, and control system interfaces.

·   Identify, resolve, and document technical issues, deviations, and design changes with consistency and traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

Supplier, procurement, and workshop coordination

·   Prepare technical purchase requirements and support procurement RFQs and purchase planning.

·   Review supplier quotations, drawings, datasheets, quality documentation, and technical deviations against project requirements.

·   Coordinate technical clarifications with suppliers and subcontractors, consolidate comments, manage revisions, and ensure closure of open actions.

·   Act as the day-to-day E&I contact for workshops and fabrication partners, responding to technical questions and resolving practical installation issues.

·   Participate in inspections, pre-FAT, FAT, and commissioning support, and follow up on punch items, deviations, and non-conformities.

·   Contribute to practical, standardized, and cost-effective E&I solutions based on lessons learned from fabrication, FAT, and commissioning.

Qualifications

We expect you to have:

·   A relevant technical background, for example as an Electrical Engineer, Automation Engineer, Automation Technologist, Marine Engineer, Electrical Technician, Industrial Electrician, or similar. Practical industrial E&I experience is more important than a specific academic title.

·   Hands-on knowledge of electrical installations for industrial machinery, automation systems, control panels, or process plants.

·   Documented experience specifying and selecting electric motors. This is essential.

·   Experience using EPLAN or another relevant ECAD system and the ability to read, review, and technically assess electrical drawings and software logic.

·   A good understanding of instrumentation, I/O systems, control interfaces, and process control philosophy.

·   Experience from project-based engineering, machinery construction, process plants, maintenance, workshops, fabrication, or EPC-type environments.

·   Familiarity with relevant standards such as EN, IEC, UL, and NFPA, together with experience of or strong understanding of ATEX requirements.

·   Experience working with controlled documentation, revisions, BOM structures, and document management systems.

·   Strong English communication skills, written and spoken. Danish is considered an advantage.

Your personal profile

You are analytical, highly structured, and able to maintain a clear overview across several parallel projects. You enjoy reading specifications and standards and converting them into practical, commercially sound requirements. You are curious and eager to learn, but your desire to understand the details never comes at the expense of progress and delivery.

You take ownership, make decisions, and follow tasks through to completion. In dialogue with suppliers and colleagues, you communicate honestly and directly while remaining constructive and respectful. You are comfortable challenging technical input and can be persistent when you know that a requirement or solution is correct.

Most importantly, you combine attention to technical quality with a sharp awareness of cost, deadlines, manufacturability, and the practical realities of installation and commissioning.

Practical information

·   Location: FLOWVISION A/S, Odense, Denmark

·   Reporting line: Chief Operating Officer (COO)

·   Travel activity: Limited and dependent on projects, including supplier visits, FAT, installation, and commissioning support

What we offer

FLOWVISION offers a unique opportunity to become part of a highly specialized and growing international engineering company where technical know-how and collaboration are the core drivers of success.

We offer:

·   A key technical role with visible impact on international engineering projects.

·   The opportunity to work with advanced E&I solutions across the full project lifecycle.

·   A strong concentration of specialist competencies and close collaboration across disciplines.

·   Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development as the company continues its growth and professionalization journey.

·   A high degree of responsibility and influence on engineering solutions, supplier coordination, project execution, and ways of working.

·   A flat organization with fast decision-making and close collaboration across the company.

·   A versatile and dynamic workday characterized by openness, cooperation, flexibility, and humor.

·   Office location in Odense with international exposure and limited travel activity.

FLOWVISION is a company where highly skilled people work closely together to deliver complex solutions to global customers - and where the right person will have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both projects and the future development of the business.

Application

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

You’ll take part in developing and executing trading strategies and continuously analyzing market trends to identify profitable opportunities. You will be responsible for monitoring real-time data, making quick decisions, and collaborating with our full-time traders to ensure we seize the right market opportunities. • A fast-paced, global environment where entrepreneurial thinking is celebrated

• A people-centered leadership approach with a flat organizational structure

You have spent years working with command-and-control systems in the field — and you know exactly what they can do, and where they fall short. Now imagine applying that expertise to help define how battle-proven C2 technology protects power grids, police forces, national crisis authorities and critical infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to move at the frontier of a genuinely new domain, with the market-leading platform and the mandate to shape it._

**The job

**

As Senior Domain Advisor, you'll be the go-to SitaWare expert across Systematic's National Security & Infrastructure (NSI) unit — the person colleagues, customers, and partners turn to when deep functional knowledge and operational credibility matter most. You'll configure and demonstrate SitaWare solutions in presales processes and customer engagements, and feed real-world operational insight directly into product development and roadmap discussions.

Equally important is your outward-facing role. Systematic is actively building its position as a thought leader at the intersection of defence-grade C2 technology and civil security — and you'll be central to that effort. Working across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, you'll help customers in emergency services, critical infrastructure, police, and national crisis authorities understand what SitaWare can do for them, and you'll identify the new workflows and use cases that will take it further.

In short, you can look forward to:

•    Acting as SitaWare superuser: configuring and demonstrating solutions across presales, bids, and senior customer engagements

•    Translating military operational experience into concrete product and solution opportunities for the NSI domain

•    Advising product management and development teams — connecting real-world needs with SitaWare's evolving capabilities

•    Engaging senior stakeholders in emergency services, police, and critical infrastructure, building credibility through hands-on expertise

•    Contributing to thought leadership, use case development, and domain knowledge sharing across the unit.

**Joining the team

**

Systematic's NSI unit is one of the company's most significant growth areas, and one of its most strategically important. Built on the same SitaWare platform trusted by NATO and allied forces in more than 50 countries, NSI is translating four decades of defence-grade technology into solutions that protect the systems society depends on — from offshore energy infrastructure to national emergency coordination. The team works across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, and the connections between those domains are exactly where the most interesting challenges live.

This is a new role, and deliberately so. You'll work closely with product managers, architects, developers, and business development managers — with real influence on where the unit goes next. The team is tight knit, highly capable, and genuinely values operational domain knowledge. Your experience won't sit in a drawer here; it will drive decisions.

Join us at the start of this exciting journey – we need your expertise and positive energy to help shape the future!

You can read more about our business unit National Security here and Critical Infrastructure here.

**

•    Solid operational experience from the Danish Army or equivalent force, with hands-on use of command-and-control systems in real or exercise environments

•    Direct experience with SitaWare — as an operational user, superuser, or in a configuration or advisory capacity

•    Strong IT proficiency at superuser level

•    Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken

•    Experience supporting demonstrations, presentations or advisory work

•    Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites and Systematic offices, nationally and internationally.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more: https://systematic.com/int/careers/security-clearance/

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Product Manager for Mobile Command and Control Products

Channel your experience as an army officer into developing products that make a difference in the field. As part of Systematic’s Defence Product Management team, you will help shape the future of our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products – developed for soldiers by someone who understands the job from the inside.

The role

Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will join the product management team and collaborate closely with the Business Product Manager for our mobile C2 products. Together, you will help define the vision and strategy for our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products. A core element of your role will be day-to-day guidance of the development team as a subject matter expert, ensuring that what we decide to build is implemented in a way that works effectively for soldiers in the field.

In short, you can look forward to:

• taking ownership of daily guidance of the development team, translating agreed features into implementation that works for soldiers in the field – ensuring user satisfaction

• using your subject matter expertise to define and manage the vision and strategy for enhancing and expanding our mobile command and control products

• serving as the voice of the customer and end user when implementing product enhancements

• providing the sales team with the necessary product knowledge, sales collateral and assistance in connection with special customer visits, and representing Systematic at conferences and trade shows

• being part of change control boards, helping prioritise defects and change requests based on what matters most to soldiers in the field

Joining the team

As a result, you will have first-hand insight into military operations, command and control at battalion level and below, and how systems are introduced and used in the field. That operational perspective will enable you to understand the end user and contribute relevant expertise to the development of our mobile C2 products.

• the ability to turn operational insight and understanding of end-user needs into clear product requirements that development teams can act on

• a collaborative approach and the confidence to provide subject matter expertise across product management, development and sales teams

• strong written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and the confidence to present to larger audiences and to represent Systematic at customer presentations, user forums and conferences

We are also looking for someone who:

• is self-motivated and energetic, with a genuine drive to make a difference for the people who use the products you will help to build

This role will involve approximately 20–30 days of travel a year, visiting customers, Systematic offices and events.

We are looking for a motivated scientist with strong scientific expertise to join our international Applications team. As part of Commercial Operations, the team works closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Product Management, and R&D to help customers succeed with Evosep technology.

• Interpret complex scientific datasets and translate results into clear, actionable insights for internal teams and external audiences.

• An Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Analytical Sciences or related fields, with a strong foundation in experimental science.

• Hands-on experience developing and executing high-throughput proteomics workflows, including sample preparation, LC-MS/MS instrument operation, and data quality control in a research or product development environment.

• Strong data analysis and scientific problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate data and consider experimental design.

• Experience in biopharma setting would be a plus.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with experience in multidisciplinary teams.

• Proactive, curious, and collaborative mindset, with the motivation to contribute to a fast-moving international team.
